claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a gas cooker with 4 burners (front control panel and burner layout visible). No evidence of additional 2 burners to make 6.
Witness report notes visible flames in one photo, but does not confirm ignition method, that all burners work reliably, or that the oven heats properly; key working-condition details are not shown.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat or thermostat may be faulty (photos show the oven door/handle but not heating performance).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the oven preheating to a set temperature and the flame/heating element cycling correctly (or thermometer reading inside).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: oven not guaranteed working (discounted as a gas cooker with unverified oven).

risks.risk: Not all burners may ignite/heat evenly; visible flames may not prove ignition reliability or burner health.
risks.proof: A clip showing ignition and steady flame for each burner knob position (all 4 burners), including low-to-high adjustment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: some burners may be weak or unreliable (discounted as partially unverified working).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect parts (knobs, burner caps/grates completeness) or damaged control panel.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of every knob, burner cap/grate set, and the full control panel with parts count (showing nothing missing).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: missing/damaged parts possible (discounted for spares risk).

risks.risk: Gas compatibility issues (LPG vs natural gas) and missing regulator/hose; safety risk.
risks.proof: Photo of the gas inlet/regulator connection type plus included regulator/hose (or clear statement with photos of the exact fittings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: compatibility/regulator not included or uncertain (discounted for required purchase).

risks.risk: Safety features may be absent or non-functional (e.g., flame failure device) and there may be leaks.
risks.proof: Video/clip demonstrating flame failure behavior (if present) and a leak test result (soap-bubble test around joints) or proof of recent service.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: safety not verified (discounted due to potential repair/safety checks).

risks.risk: Condition problems not visible in the limited angles (rust, dents, cracks, glass top/oven door damage).
risks.proof: Full inspection photos: top glass/metal surface, oven door glass, sides/back, and underside/feet; include close-ups of any rust/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: cosmetic/structural wear possible (discounted for refurbishment risk).

proof_requests: Confirm burner count with a clear photo showing all burners and the full top layout (prove whether it is 4 gas burners only or truly 6 total).
Send a video showing ignition and steady flame for each of the 4 burners (low to high) and confirm all knobs operate correctly.
Send a video of the oven heating (preheat to a stated temperature) and show a thermometer reading or clear heating cycle.
Provide close-ups of every knob, burner caps/grates, and the full control panel to confirm no missing/damaged parts.
Show the gas inlet connection and include photos of the regulator/hose (or confirm they are not included).
Show safety verification: flame failure device test (if present) and a leak test around all joints (soap-bubble check).
Provide full condition photos for rust/dents/cracks on top, sides, back, and oven door/glass.
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies the item type as a gas cooker with oven and 4 burners, so it can be priced at the worst case for unverified oven/safety/parts. The seller’s claim of 6 burners is contradicted by the witness observations.
